title: Efficient iodine capture from water using a functionalized covalent organic framework
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,10129-10139
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09537A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mahsa Jahantigh, Mostafa Khajeh, Ali Reza Oveisi, Saba Daliran, Mansoureh Rakhshanipour
An amidoxime-functionalized COF-366 enables ultrafast, high-capacity molecular iodine capture from water (909.1 mg g−1), driven by charge-transfer interactions, with excellent reusability over seven cycles.
